output: html_document

## 1. Metagenome assembly
Oxford Nanopore reads were assembled using Flye in metagenome mode. This step produced assembled contigs for the BBD microbial community.
```{bash, eval=FALSE}
flye --nano-hq ../flye/bbd_0.1.fastq.gz \
  --threads 12 \
  --out-dir bbd \
  --meta
```
The primary output was assembly.fasta, containing the assembled metagenomic contigs.

## 2. Genome binning MetaBAT2

Contig depth information was extracted from the Flye assembly output.

```{bash, eval=FALSE}
cat ../flye/bbd/assembly_info.txt |
  grep -v '#' |
  awk '{OFS="\t"; print $1,$3}' \
  > depths_bbd.txt
```

The contigs were reordered to match the order of the depth file.

```{bash, eval=FALSE}
cat depths_bbd.txt |
  awk '{print $1}' |
  xargs samtools faidx ../flye/bbd/assembly.fasta \
  > assembly_bbd_ordered.fasta
```

MetaBAT2 was used to group the assembled contigs into genome bins.

```{bash, eval=FALSE}
metabat2 \
  -i assembly_bbd_ordered.fasta \
  -a depths_bbd.txt \
  --cvExt \
  -o bins_bbd/metabat \
  --seed 5
```

## 3. Gene annotation with Prokka

Prokka was used to identify genes and assign predicted functions to the selected genome bins.

```{bash, eval=FALSE}
while read bin; do
  prokka \
    --outdir "$bin" \
    --prefix "$bin" \
    "../metabat/bins_bbd/${bin}.fa"
done < ../checkm/bbd_topbins.txt
```

## 4. Metabolic pathway analysis with MinPath

Genes with EC numbers were extracted from the Prokka annotation files.

```{bash, eval=FALSE}
while read bin; do
  cat ../prokka/$bin/${bin}.tsv |
    awk -F '\t' '$5 {
      printf("%s\t%s\n", $1,$5)
    }' |
    grep -v '^locus' \
    > ${bin}.ec
done < ../checkm/bbd_topbins.txt
```

MinPath was used to infer metabolic pathways within each selected genome bin.

```{bash, eval=FALSE}
while read bin; do
  minpath \
    -ec ${bin}.ec \
    -report ${bin}.ec.report \
    -details ${bin}.ec.details
done < ../checkm/bbd_topbins.txt
```

## 5. Identification of photosynthesis pathways

The photosynthesis light-reaction pathway `PWY-101` was searched across all MinPath reports.

```{bash, eval=FALSE}
grep 'PWY-101' *.ec.report
```

## 6. Linking pathway results with taxonomy

The GTDB-Tk classification of `metabat.35` was retrieved from the bacterial summary file.

```{bash, eval=FALSE}
grep -P '^metabat\.35\t' \
  ../gtdbtk/out/gtdbtk.bac120.summary.tsv
```
